justifications.goal_fidelity: the deliverable lands - _review_brief_text composes the rubric verbatim (load_review_prompt for a landed run, load_claims_review_prompt for a read-only run) followed by the reviewed run id, the head it read and the reviewed run's stored brief path when it carried one (_review_brief_text, recovery_review_subject.py), and _review_dispatch_tokens emits --brief beside --plan/--section for a plan-naming run while a brief-only run emits --brief alone; I confirmed the brief carries the SCORE emission block and every REVIEW_DIMENSIONS name (tests/test_a_review_receives_its_rubric.py:156-159 pass) and the plan-naming argv carries both pairs (line 233).
justifications.reuse: the composer reuses review_module.load_review_prompt/load_claims_review_prompt, runs.run_dir and runs._write_json and extends the owner _review_dispatch_fields rather than forking it, and _review_brief_path shares the single brief-name constant with the writing path; no second copy of the brief-path resolution is added.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch exactly reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py and tests/test_a_review_receives_its_rubric.py, both inside the section write paths; nothing outside the fence is modified; the only gratuitous edit is a cosmetic reflow of the subprocess.run(...) blob expression in the plan branch, which changes no behaviour.
